messages:
alex.k: Quick question — Novara Health POC asking for a temporary burst carveout. They want 4x A100 reserved (monthly commit) with ability to burst to 10x for ~2 hours per day during nightly batches. Can we approve an exception on burst billing for the POC window?

maria_s: Do we have their expected token/hour or throughput numbers? need to map to cost impact.

alex.k: They sent estimates: batch jobs produce ~300M tokens during the 2h window. Rough expected extra GPU hours ~12 GPU-hours/day (on top of reserved). POC length 30 days.

sam_t: Thanks — important to know if autoscale will spin up extra cards in same pool or new ephemeral nodes. If ephemeral, burst billing applies at on-demand rate.

jordan_pm: We discussed a POC-friendly rate: apply a 30% discount on burst-hours for the 30d window, capped at 250 extra GPU-hours total. Also add a hard cap to prevent runaway usage. Is that acceptable? :thinking_face: @finance_bot please confirm.

finance_bot: AUTOMATED: Deal desk intake created (DD-2026-311). Please provide final commit terms and justify discount. Attach Security SQ if needed.

maria_s: FYI security sent the standard questionnaire; Novara wants a copy of our SOC2 section and encryption detail before signing. ops_oncall, can we share sanitized logs?

ops_oncall: We can share SOC2 excerpt + KMS architecture diagram. Will redact customer-specific rows.

alex.k: Proposed rate snippet for approval:

```
Committed: 4x A100 (monthly) - base rate $X/hr per GPU
Burst: additional GPU-hours for POC - standard on-demand rate $Y/hr per GPU
POC Exception: 30% discount on Burst (30d), cap 250 GPU-hours, max burst concurrency 10x
Penalty: if we exceed cap, on-demand rate applies, ops reserves right to throttle.
```

sam_t: Need to ensure this doesn't create SLA expectation for production. Add copy that POC burst exception is non-recurring and not covered by Dedicated SLA.

jordan_pm: Agreed. I'll add a clause to the SOW. Also we should log this in Deal Desk so revenue recognizes as usage, not committed capacity.

finance_bot: REVIEW: Suggested approval path — Sales Manager -> Revenue Ops -> Head of Partnerships. Discount magnitude below 40% so it's approvable by Revenue Ops with manager signoff.

alex.k: Can someone from Revenue Ops give a quick thumbs? We need to tell the customer today. :pray:

maria_s: @sam_t can you confirm the cost delta so Revenue Ops can sign? I ran rough calc: 250 GPU-hours * (Y * 0.7) = est $Z; looks acceptable but need final.

sam_t: I'll run the exact numbers and post in 30m. Also adding a fallback policy: if burst capacity unavailable, route to smaller model quantized variant (2.7B) to keep batch latency within target.

jordan_pm: Perfect. If Revenue Ops approves, I'll update SOW and attach security excerpt.

alex.k: Great — thanks all. I'll hold off the customer commit until we have final signoff.

sam_t: posted numbers: additional cost after discount ~ $18,750 for the POC (under cap). Requesting Revenue Ops approval.

finance_bot: DEAL DESK NOTE: Revenue Ops approved provisional 30% POC burst discount (Req DD-2026-311), subject to SOW clause & SOC2 excerpt attachment.

maria_s: Awesome — Alex, please push SOW and quote to Novara and mark thread resolved when sent. :white_check_mark:

alex.k: Sent SOW and quote, included SOC2 excerpt. Customer replied "approved, will sign EOD". Closing. :tada:
